::: {#exm-walk}
#### A walk in the office graph

In a simple graph (@def-simple-graph), the vertices of a walk (@def-walk) name its edges,
so we write the walk as its list of vertices.
In the office graph (@fig-office),

$$
a, b, c, a, b, d
$$

is a walk of length 5 from $a$ to $d$,
along the edges $\set{a, b}$, $\set{b, c}$, $\set{c, a}$, $\set{a, b}$ and $\set{b, d}$.
It uses the edge $\set{a, b}$ twice.
A single vertex, such as $a$, is a walk of length 0 from $a$ to $a$.

:::
